analyst.summary: IIFL Finance's 160% profit growth this quarter looks dramatic but is largely a recovery off a low base - the company's gold-loan business was under an RBI-imposed embargo in 2024 that has since been lifted, and the franchise is now rebuilding that book (gold loan assets under management are up 85% year-on-year). Growth is real and the co-lending partnerships with banks are expanding again, but Indian regulators continue to tighten gold-loan lending norms industry-wide, so this remains a business with genuine regulatory-relationship risk alongside its recovery story. We would not extrapolate the current growth rate forward at face value.
